# Global News Shorts

> Global News Shorts — the important USA and world news, in short videos. Daily clips, straight to the point.

## Clips

- [Fauci Pleads the Fifth](https://globalnewsshorts.com/clips/fauci-pleads-the-fifth/): Sen. Josh Hawley grills Dr. Fauci in a Senate hearing — asking what day of the week it is, what color tie he's wearing — and gets the Fifth Amendment every time. 111 invocations, zero answers.
- [Hawley Grills Fauci on 111 Fifth Amendment Invocations](https://globalnewsshorts.com/clips/hawley-grills-fauci/): Sen. Hawley explains why he asked Dr. Fauci about his tie and the carpet: to test the good faith of 111 Fifth Amendment invocations — including questions with no fear of prosecution. “That is an abuse… there's no privilege for any of that.”
- [France Student Protests: Tear Gas in Paris as Hundreds of Thousands March](https://globalnewsshorts.com/clips/france-student-protests-tear-gas/): France's student protest wave peaks on October 6 with a national day of demonstrations: 256,000 marchers counted by the Interior Ministry, 450,000 by organizers, up to 100,000 in Paris marching from République to Nation. What began September 21 at a Créteil high school over teacher shortages, overcrowded classes and crumbling buildings has spread nationwide — 24 schools burned or ransacked, 78 staff injured, over 6,500 arrested, mostly minors. Police fired tear gas as the Paris march ended; Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu suspended classes through the week.
